correctness.rationale: For 1<=r<=l<d, full-row-rank J and nonzero e, JG has rank r almost surely. The orthogonal decomposition into h_* and ker J is exact. For coefficient minimization, Gaussian block independence and the row-Wishart Schur complement produce chi²_(d-r)/chi²_(l-r+1). For physical min-norm on the same Haar l-plane, represent its orthogonal complement with a q by s Gaussian block and use a second Schur complement to produce chi²_(d-l)/chi²_(l-r+1). Numerator-denominator independence is established separately for each marginal; no false independence of the paired actual errors is asserted. Gamma integrals prove the exact p<l-r+1 finite-moment range and the infinite endpoints, including the l=r and l=r+1 cases. The finite QR/Python checks pass 1742 assertions and the exact witness uses rational arithmetic; they are supporting checks, not the infinite proof. No finite-precision or iteration theorem is claimed.

value.rationale: The smallest positive-rank exact-fit linearized least-squares model with a redundant Gaussian parameter sketch has nonunique subspace minimizers, so pseudoinverse tie-breaking is a motivated numerical choice rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The theorem quantifies basis-induced physical displacement: same residual zero and same random span can have different chi-squared excess numerator dimensions, with sharp infinite-vs-finite squared-step moment boundary after two extra sketch directions. This is a full classification of a natural implementation ambiguity and a benchmark for step normalization/trust controls; it does not claim a new Gaussian primitive or global convergence advantage.
